info.title: React Admin Starter API
info.description: Same-origin cookie sessions. Generated from src/contract by `pnpm contract:generate`; do not edit by hand. Every write must send `X-Requested-With: ReactAdminStarter`; authenticated writes also send `X-CSRF-Token`. Development MSW is a demonstration only.

post.summary: Sign in and start a cookie session

400.description:
`INVALID_REQUEST`: The request body is not valid JSON.

`INVALID_CREDENTIALS_FORMAT`: Login body does not contain a valid email and password.

401.description: `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`: Login failed: unknown email or wrong password.

403.description: `REQUEST_HEADER_REQUIRED`: Missing `X-Requested-With: ReactAdminStarter` header.

get.summary: Validate the current session and return identity and grants

401.description: `UNAUTHENTICATED`: No valid session: missing, expired, revoked or unknown cookie.

post.summary: Revoke the session and clear the cookie

`INVALID_CSRF_TOKEN`: Missing or mismatching `X-CSRF-Token` on an authenticated write.

ErrorCode.description:
`UNAUTHENTICATED` (401): No valid session: missing, expired, revoked or unknown cookie.

`INVALID_CREDENTIALS` (401): Login failed: unknown email or wrong password.

`INVALID_REQUEST` (400): The request body is not valid JSON.

`INVALID_CREDENTIALS_FORMAT` (400): Login body does not contain a valid email and password.

`REQUEST_HEADER_REQUIRED` (403): Missing `X-Requested-With: ReactAdminStarter` header.

`INVALID_CSRF_TOKEN` (403): Missing or mismatching `X-CSRF-Token` on an authenticated write.

`FORBIDDEN` (403): The session lacks the capability the operation requires.

`DATA_SCOPE_DENIED` (403): The record, or a record in a batch, is outside the actor data scope. Batches are rejected atomically.

`USER_NOT_FOUND` (404): No user with the given id.

`INVALID_USER_FIELDS` (422): A required user field is empty, or email/role is invalid.

`DUPLICATE_USER` (422): Email or username already exists.

`INVALID_STATUS` (422): Bulk status must be `active` or `inactive`.

`INVALID_EMAIL` (422): Invitation email is not a valid address.

`INVALID_ROLE` (422): Role is not one of the allowed values.

`FILE_REQUIRED` (422): Upload has no `file` part.

`UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE` (422): Only image uploads are accepted.

`FILE_TOO_LARGE` (422): Upload exceeds 2 MB.

`INVALID_FIELDS` (422): A system-management body failed schema validation.

`SYSTEM_RULE` (401, 403, 404, 409, 422): A system-management business rule rejected the change: stale session (401), delegation or scope limits (403), unknown record (404), protected record, duplicate or still-referenced record (409), invalid reference or hierarchy (422).

`NOT_FOUND` (404): Unknown system resource or unsupported path.

`INVALID_METHOD` (400): HTTP method does not match the resource path.

RequestedWith.description: Required on every write; missing it returns 403 REQUEST_HEADER_REQUIRED before any session check.
